assertions.text: The output does NOT silently resolve the stacking/cap ambiguity — it leaves the conflicting cases as open questions, blank cells, or explicitly marks them as unresolved
Table includes at least one row where both bulk and loyalty discounts apply simultaneously (exposing the interaction)
The unresolved decision (stacking vs. higher-only vs. cap) is explicitly surfaced — via an Open Questions column, a '?' cell, or a note
At least one output column ends with '?'

Table includes at least one row with a high combined discount (e.g. large order + top loyalty tier) that would force a decision about whether a cap applies — making the cap question concrete, not theoretical.
Table has a scenario/description column as the leftmost column
